meta.name: pytorch-lightning
meta.description: High-level PyTorch framework with Trainer class, automatic distributed training (DDP/FSDP/DeepSpeed), callbacks system, and minimal boilerplate. Scales from laptop to supercomputer with same code. Use when you want clean training loops with built-in best practices.

copy.tagline: 用极简代码实现分布式深度学习训练
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用PyTorch做分布式训练但不想写样板代码
copy.tagline_en: Run distributed deep learning with minimal code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want distributed PyTorch training without boilerplate

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 PyTorch Lightning 框架编写训练代码。它会自动处理 GPU/TPU 切换、分布式训练（DDP/FSDP/DeepSpeed）、混合精度、梯度累积、检查点保存和日志记录，让你只需关注模型和数据。
howto.when: 当你需要训练 PyTorch 模型，并希望代码简洁、自动支持多 GPU 或 TPU 时触发。例如，你描述一个训练任务，要求使用 Lightning 的 Trainer 类。

say.text: 将这段 PyTorch 训练代码改写成 Lightning 版本。
say.note: Claude 会重构代码，移除设备管理和手动循环。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write training code using the PyTorch Lightning framework. It automatically handles GPU/TPU switching, distributed training (DDP/FSDP/DeepSpeed), mixed precision, gradient accumulation, checkpointing, and logging, letting you focus on model and data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to train a PyTorch model and want clean code with automatic multi-GPU/TPU support. For example, you describe a training task and ask to use Lightning's Trainer class.

say_en.text: Write a PyTorch Lightning training script for MNIST classifier.
say_en.note: Claude generates LightningModule and Trainer code.

say_en.text: Convert this PyTorch training code to Lightning version.
say_en.note: Claude refactors code, removing device management and manual loops.
